subject: Can someone please explain to me what "Passing functions to 'reactive' is deprecated." means

messages.author: c1d956e2355f9e90
messages.subject: Can someone please explain to me what "Passing functions to 'reactive' is deprecated." means
parts:
I recently updated to 0.4.0 and now I'm getting this warning along with a host of other warnings. But I thought I'd focus on this one first.
 I can follow this up with code/context if needed, but I thought this was more of a conceptual type question.

Thank you for any and all help.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Can someone please explain to me what "Passing functions to 'reactive' is deprecated." means
parts:
You used to do this:

foo <- reactive(function() {
  data <- read.csv('foo.csv')
  subset(data, !is.na(data$total))
})

With 0.4.0, you remove the "function()" part of it. The below is exactly equivalent to the above, only without the deprecation warning:

foo <- reactive({
  data <- read.csv('foo.csv')
  subset(data, !is.na(data$total))
})
